svg.title: Repo constellation: smaller repositories grouped by theme
svg.desc: A star chart groups smaller repositories into five constellations: FastAPI patterns (fastapi_practices, fastapi_sql_aws_base); Frontend and 3D (Babylon_Vue, react-basics-rejuvenation, AngularInMemoryCompanyAdmin); Containers (flask_mongo_dockerized, heroku_deploy_flask); DSA galaxy (dsa_algo with 140 files drawn as a 140-dot spiral, blind_leetcode_python with 53 problem files); Tools (github-stats, Flask and pygal).
svg.text: Smaller builds, grouped by theme. Links are listed under the chart.
star size = curation tier, not popularity
